title: Publication of the Section 232 Report on NdFeB Permanent Magnets
publisher_or_origin: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security / Federal Register
time_period_covered: Report completed June 2022; demand baseline 2020-2030; industry data through 2021/2022
claims_supported: Magnet composition; production steps; 54-81% alloy-to-magnet recovery; U.S. demand forecast; direct versus embedded imports; demand-estimate limitations
important_definitions: Sintered versus bonded; total demand equals direct plus embedded demand; quantities called tons are metric unless noted
limitations: Industry state and project forecasts are stale relative to 2026; demand estimates are explicitly described as opaque and uncertain
notes: Load-bearing source for definitions, demand denominator, and material-flow sensitivity.

title: Rare Earth Elements: Executive Summary
time_period_covered: Global market through early 2026; outlook to 2035
claims_supported: China concentration; uneven project pipeline; magnet manufacturing and metallisation bottlenecks; equipment constraints
important_definitions: Magnet rare earths are Nd, Pr, Dy and Tb; project capacity presented on rare-earth-content basis
limitations: Global and aggregate; does not audit individual U.S. finished-magnet projects
notes: Used to place the U.S. project stack inside the global bottleneck.

title: MP Materials Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results

title: General Motors and Noveon Magnetics Multi-Year Supply Agreement
